annotations.text:
Player report redesign — real David2 numbers throughout (6 sessions, 29–31 Aug).

Matches the shipped report's design system exactly: teal #0f766e, Iowan Old Style / Palatino headings, 14px cards, 840px column.

Five sections left to right, then the phone width at 390.

HERO: the estimate plus its firming-up.

The evidence strip is real — 28, 38, 45, 55, 67, 80 of your shots across the six sessions.

"Rating over time" is gone, per your call. Nothing on this canvas is invented now.

EVERY measurement is here, in a table per category.

The "worth" column is measured, not guessed: each driver was perturbed by 10 points through the real rate.py scorers.

Weight strip at the top: intended share vs share actually carried. Strategy is meant to carry 20% and is carrying 39%.

CORRECTED: a row that moves nothing is now sorted into four honest buckets, and the red one is a real hole. Unforced errors sits there — USAPA rates it plainly (3.0 "frequent", 3.5 "fewer", 5.0 "very few") and we cannot measure it, because rally-end reason is 8/23 and the top confusion is net vs not-returned, the exact winner/error flip.

TOGGLES ARE LIVE — click through the five views.

Positioning is three zones with %, per your direction. Opponents shows an honest empty state: opp_b has zero tracked frames and opp_a reads 3% kitchen, which cannot be right.

Ball views are plotted marks, not density — 5 to 20 points each is far too few to shade. Blue = bounce, red = out or net, green = volley.
The measurement caveats that used to be footnotes now live here as four collapsible answers — good info, only for those interested.
